subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: Add FR-15 for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode through existing runtime adapters and native routing. A job records its harness and semantic routing requirements; native model/effort selection and invocation translation reuse existing owners. Update scope, FR-2/FR-10, integrations, and verification consistently. Codex remains an explicit choice for the initial job.
rationale: Pyxis already supports “4 different harness” and “a job can simply have the config for the harness and the routing”; the operator accepted the proposed capability/deliberation/context/assurance shape with “sounds good”.
